answer: Sequential VDF admission: every agent identity must finish a 6-hour verifiable delay function each epoch to keep its seat. A VDF can't be parallelized, so like a zephyr moving a dune grain by grain, time can't be bought in bulk. 1,000 sybils need 1,000 dedicated cores x 6 h = 6,000 core-hours per epoch; at ~$0.04/core-hour that's ~$240 every epoch, forever, while an honest agent spends cents. Verification takes milliseconds, so peers check cheaply, and one ember of steady honest compute is all a real participant needs.
